MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Special City Council Meeting
  March 10, 2026

A Special Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority, the
Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the
Library Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor
Bucknum at 4:30 p.m., on March 10, 2026, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on March 5, 2026, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. A copy was also posted
at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive and Norman P. Murray
Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

  Council Member Kelley
Present:  Council Member Vasquez
  Mayor Pro Tem Goodell
  Mayor Bucknum

Absent:  Council Member Ruesch

Staff Present:  Elaine Lister, City Manager
  Jerry Hill, Assistant City Manager
  Ellis Chang, Director of Administrative Services
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk
  Renata Winter, Assistant City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENTS

NEW BUSINESS

1. Agreement for City Attorney Services

  Motion made by Council Member Goodell, seconded by Council Member Vasquez to approve
  the agreement with Jones Mayer Law (A26-07) to provide City Attorney Services to the City.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, and Vasquez
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Ruesch

.

City Council Minutes  1  March 10, 2026
  At the hour of 4:34 pm, with no further business to come before the City Council at this session, Mayor
 Bucknum adjourned the meeting to Tuesday, March 10, 2026, at 5:00 p.m.

 ______________________________________
 Kimberly Schmitt
 City Clerk
